1use crate::config::ObservationVisibility;
2use crate::encode::{
3    encode_obs_context, encode_obs_header, encode_obs_player_block_into, encode_obs_reason,
4    encode_obs_reveal, encode_observation_with_slot_power,
5};
6
7use super::{GameEnv, StepOutcome};
8
9impl GameEnv {
10    pub(super) fn touch_player_obs(&mut self, player: u8) {
11        let p = player as usize;
12        if p < 2 {
13            self.player_obs_version[p] = self.player_obs_version[p].wrapping_add(1);
14        }
15    }
16
17    pub(super) fn refresh_player_block_cache(&mut self, player: u8) {
18        let p = player as usize;
19        if p >= 2 {
20            return;
21        }
22        let visibility = self.config.observation_visibility;
23        let memory_self = true;
24        let memory_opp =
25            visibility == ObservationVisibility::Full || self.curriculum.memory_is_public;
26        let hand_self = true;
27        let hand_opp = visibility == ObservationVisibility::Full;
28        let stock_self = true;
29        let stock_opp = visibility == ObservationVisibility::Full;
30        let deck_self = true;
31        let deck_opp = visibility == ObservationVisibility::Full;
32        let hand_count_self = true;
33        let stock_count_self = true;
34        let private_counts_opp = visibility == ObservationVisibility::Full
35            || self.curriculum.reveal_opponent_hand_stock_counts;
36        encode_obs_player_block_into(
37            &self.state,
38            &self.db,
39            player,
40            memory_self,
41            hand_count_self,
42            hand_self,
43            stock_count_self,
44            stock_self,
45            deck_self,
46            &self.slot_power_cache,
47            &mut self.player_block_cache_self[p],
48        );
49        encode_obs_player_block_into(
50            &self.state,
51            &self.db,
52            player,
53            memory_opp,
54            private_counts_opp,
55            hand_opp,
56            private_counts_opp,
57            stock_opp,
58            deck_opp,
59            &self.slot_power_cache,
60            &mut self.player_block_cache_opp[p],
61        );
62        self.player_block_cache_version[p] = self.player_obs_version[p];
63    }
64
65    /// Build a `StepOutcome` without cloning the observation buffer.
66    pub(crate) fn build_outcome_no_copy(&mut self, reward: f32) -> StepOutcome {
67        self.build_outcome_with_obs(reward, false)
68    }
69
70    /// Build a `StepOutcome`, encoding observations as needed.
71    ///
72    /// A full re-encode is used when global observation context changed; else a
73    /// partial update path patches header/reason/reveal/context plus any dirty
74    /// per-player blocks. This keeps output deterministic while avoiding
75    /// repeated full-buffer writes.
76    pub(crate) fn build_outcome_with_obs(&mut self, reward: f32, copy_obs: bool) -> StepOutcome {
77        let perspective = self
78            .decision
79            .as_ref()
80            .map(|d| d.player)
81            .unwrap_or(self.last_perspective);
82        let (p0, p1) = match perspective {
83            0 => (0usize, 1usize),
84            1 => (1usize, 0usize),
85            _ => {
86                debug_assert!(perspective < 2, "invalid perspective");
87                (0usize, 1usize)
88            }
89        };
90        let perspective_changed = self.obs_perspective != perspective;
91        let p0_dirty = self.player_block_cache_version[p0] != self.player_obs_version[p0];
92        let p1_dirty = self.player_block_cache_version[p1] != self.player_obs_version[p1];
93        let full_encode = self.obs_dirty || perspective_changed || (p0_dirty && p1_dirty);
94        if full_encode {
95            self.refresh_slot_power_cache();
96            encode_observation_with_slot_power(
97                &self.state,
98                &self.db,
99                &self.curriculum,
100                perspective,
101                self.decision.as_ref(),
102                self.last_action_desc.as_ref(),
103                self.last_action_player,
104                self.config.observation_visibility,
105                &self.slot_power_cache,
106                &mut self.obs_buf,
107            );
108            self.obs_dirty = false;
109            self.obs_perspective = perspective;
110            self.refresh_player_block_cache(0);
111            self.refresh_player_block_cache(1);
112        } else {
113            encode_obs_header(
114                &self.state,
115                perspective,
116                self.decision.as_ref(),
117                self.last_action_desc.as_ref(),
118                self.last_action_player,
119                self.config.observation_visibility,
120                &mut self.obs_buf,
121            );
122            encode_obs_reason(
123                &self.state,
124                &self.db,
125                &self.curriculum,
126                perspective,
127                self.decision.as_ref(),
128                &mut self.obs_buf,
129            );
130            encode_obs_reveal(&self.state, perspective, &mut self.obs_buf);
131            encode_obs_context(&self.state, &mut self.obs_buf);
132            if p0_dirty || p1_dirty {
133                self.refresh_slot_power_cache();
134            }
135            if p0_dirty {
136                self.refresh_player_block_cache(perspective);
137            }
138            if p1_dirty && !p0_dirty {
139                self.refresh_player_block_cache(p1 as u8);
140            }
141            if p0_dirty || p1_dirty {
142                let base0 = crate::encode::OBS_HEADER_LEN;
143                let base1 = base0 + crate::encode::PER_PLAYER_BLOCK_LEN;
144                self.obs_buf[base0..base0 + crate::encode::PER_PLAYER_BLOCK_LEN]
145                    .copy_from_slice(&self.player_block_cache_self[p0]);
146                self.obs_buf[base1..base1 + crate::encode::PER_PLAYER_BLOCK_LEN]
147                    .copy_from_slice(&self.player_block_cache_opp[p1]);
148            }
149        }
150        let obs = if copy_obs {
151            self.obs_buf.clone()
152        } else {
153            Vec::new()
154        };
155        let info = super::EnvInfo {
156            obs_version: crate::encode::OBS_ENCODING_VERSION,
157            action_version: crate::encode::ACTION_ENCODING_VERSION,
158            decision_kind: self
159                .decision
160                .as_ref()
161                .map(|d| match d.kind {
162                    crate::legal::DecisionKind::Mulligan => 0,
163                    crate::legal::DecisionKind::Clock => 1,
164                    crate::legal::DecisionKind::Main => 2,
165                    crate::legal::DecisionKind::Climax => 3,
166                    crate::legal::DecisionKind::AttackDeclaration => 4,
167                    crate::legal::DecisionKind::LevelUp => 5,
168                    crate::legal::DecisionKind::Encore => 6,
169                    crate::legal::DecisionKind::TriggerOrder => 7,
170                    crate::legal::DecisionKind::Choice => 8,
171                })
172                .unwrap_or(crate::encode::DECISION_KIND_NONE),
173            current_player: self.decision.as_ref().map(|d| d.player as i8).unwrap_or(-1),
174            actor: self.last_perspective as i8,
175            decision_count: self.state.turn.decision_count,
176            tick_count: self.state.turn.tick_count,
177            terminal: self.state.terminal,
178            illegal_action: self.last_illegal_action,
179            engine_error: self.last_engine_error,
180            engine_error_code: self.last_engine_error_code as u8,
181        };
182        let truncated = matches!(
183            self.state.terminal,
184            Some(crate::state::TerminalResult::Timeout)
185        );
186        let terminated = matches!(
187            self.state.terminal,
188            Some(crate::state::TerminalResult::Win { .. } | crate::state::TerminalResult::Draw)
189        );
190        StepOutcome {
191            obs,
192            reward,
193            terminated,
194            truncated,
195            info,
196        }
197    }
198}
